newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two Philippine firms set capital increases.
newsitem.headline: Two Philippine firms set capital increases.

text.p: Baguio Gold Holdings Corp and PICOP Resources Inc said separately on Tuesday that they had decided to increase their authorised capital stock.
PICOP, which is a paper and pulp manufacturer, told the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) its board had agreed to raise its capital to 10 billion pesos from the present 6.0 billion pesos.
It had also approved a resolution to undertake a stock split to 10 billion shares, worth 1.0 peso each, from 1.2 billion shares of 5.00 pesos each.
In a separate disclosure, Baguio said its stockholders had approved a resolution to increase its stock to one billion pesos from the present 200 million pesos.
